status: written while pilot is running, before inspecting any pilot outcomes
estimand: Equal-weight mean paired score difference across the eight pre-frozen Rest/no-Rest cases (four families each); on-pool controls excluded. Equal Rest/no-Rest weighting is a stress-benchmark assumption, not human frequency.
model: Independent symmetric Dirichlet joint paired outcome model in each case over nine (A,B) scores in {0,0.5,1} squared, total prior mass per case. Average case posterior expected scores with equal weights.
caps: Unknown; do not discard or impute as draws. Report empirical worst/best difference bounds. Posterior declared incomplete when any analyzed case has a cap.
screen: No adoption from this pilot. A positive primary pilot mean allows fresh independent confirmation; any candidate adoption still requires the previously accepted model-conditional 80% improvement probability rule and consideration of non-Rest/control outcomes and prior sensitivity. Retain the default if support is absent. No human-superiority claim.
